inclusions.text: Meet at Cairo International Airport and transfer to hotel
inclusions.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and transferred to your hotel; no monuments, no programme, just arrival.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Cairo International Airport
itinerary.source: You are met at Cairo International Airport and transferred to your hotel; no monuments, no programme, just arrival.

itinerary.title: Giza plateau, Egyptian Museum, Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: In the evening you board the sleeping train south toward Aswan — a practical crossing of the distance that also happens to be one of the more atmospheric ways to travel in Egypt.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Aswan, board cruise
itinerary.source: You arrive in Aswan in the morning and board the Nile cruise ship that will be your hotel for the next three nights.

itinerary.title: Cruise sails north toward Kom Ombo
itinerary.source: The cruise sails north from Aswan toward Kom Ombo, and the hours on deck are as much the point as the destination.

itinerary.title: Edfu, the finest temple on the river
itinerary.source: Day five is anchored by Edfu, the finest temple on the river.

itinerary.title: Luxor West and East Banks, flight to Cairo
itinerary.source: The afternoon takes in Luxor Temple, the smaller East Bank complex connected to Karnak by the Avenue of Sphinxes, before a domestic flight back to Cairo.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Cairo International Airport
itinerary.source: Day seven is a transfer day: a final breakfast and the drive to Cairo International Airport, with later flights giving the option of additional hours in the city.
